name: Log Triage Assistant
headline: Classify production log lines into critical / error / warning / info / noise.
description: A 5-class classification template for SRE and platform teams drowning in log volume. Train a small model to tag every log line with its real triage priority so dashboards, alerts, and paging routes can filter on a semantic class rather than just log-level. Targets sub-50ms inference on mobile-cpu so it can run inline in a log shipper or a Fluent Bit Lua filter without a GPU round-trip.
suggested_brief: Train a 5-class log triage classifier (critical / error / warning / info / noise) for our production log stream. Class definitions: critical = page someone NOW (data loss, security breach, total outage); error = visible-to-users but not paging; warning = degraded but functioning; info = normal operation, useful for audit; noise = healthchecks, debug spam. Macro-F1 above 0.80. Must run sub-50ms on a single CPU core.
